crossRefs.note: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your…
I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.
For it is God who works in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.
make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through…
He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.
I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.
But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he…
Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “I am Yahweh your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by…
I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
“If you turn away your foot from the Sabbath, from doing your pleasure on my holy day; and call the Sabbath a delight…
then you will delight yourself in Yahweh, and I will make you to ride on the high places of the earth, and I will feed…
For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

translations.web: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
translations.bsb: Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight.
translations.kjv: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
translations.asv: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; For therein do I delight.
